name: fold
description: Fold long lines for finite width output device

options.name: -b
options.description: Count width in bytes rather than column positions

options.name: -s
options.description: Fold line after the last blank character within the first width column positions (or bytes)

options.name: -w
options.description: Specify a line width to use instead of the default 80 columns. The width value should be a multiple of 8 if tabs are present, or the tabs should be expanded…
